subject: skill/stack/docker-compose
claim: The fleet ladder attaches to the external fleet-net network and reaches data-plane services by name, including finops-queue, chromadb, and neo4j. It deliberately excludes story-agent sandbox Redis (finops-redis on port 6379), and exposes the Control Room only as 127.0.0.1:8001:8001.
notes: Repo conformance edit: removed broad Docker DNS and default-bridge assertions in favor of the ladder's explicit network, endpoint, sandbox-isolation, and loopback-publication contract.
